## About This Site
Hussaini Law Group is a multicultural law firm based in Fairfield, Sydney, NSW, Australia.
Principal solicitor: Sayed Rahmatullah Hussainizada — Law Society NSW member, Accredited Specialist.
Languages: English, Dari, Pashto, Arabic.
Phone: 02 8764 7885 | Address: 7/37 Spencer Street, Fairfield NSW 2165

## Practice Areas
- Criminal Law: court representation, bail, traffic offences, assault, drug charges, fraud, appeals
- Immigration Law: partner visas, skilled migration, family reunification, refugee/protection visas
- Family Law: divorce, property settlements, parenting orders, domestic violence
- Conveyancing: residential purchase/sale, off-the-plan, title transfers, strata title
- Commercial Law: business structuring, contracts, disputes, leases
- Civil Litigation: debt recovery, NCAT disputes, contract breaches, property disputes
